competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times and recovers 10% of the Attack Bar each time the attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects granted on them with a 90% chance. Inflicts Continuous Damage equal to the number of beneficial effects removed for 2 turns. In addition, decreases the Attack Speed of all enemies for 2 turns with a 75% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
effets.note: Equal to the number of beneficial effects removed

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on all allies, and grants Invincible for 1 turn and Immunity for 3 turns. Recovers their HP by 15% each for 3 turns afterwards.

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
The target will be invincible and receive no damage.
The target's HP will be recovered by 15% on each turn.
